g.text: Momus: data flow and trust boundaries
Two containers that share no network: only the scanner (Kali) sends packets to scan targets, and only the brain (the web application) talks to a model provider.
They exchange files through one-way folders. Every scan starts from an ownership statement and a DNS proof; the optional seeder lists host names from your own DNS.

Shown: Momus working tree of 2026-11-25 | scanner base kalilinux/kali-rolling@sha256:69a9a33d98a5 | brain and seeder base python:3.13-slim@sha256:7249d5587b78 | FastAPI 0.165.0, Starlette 1.10.0, Jinja2 3.1.6, Uvicorn 0.54.0
Brain container: web application, UI and API on 127.0.0.1:8080
Internet: scan targets and public services
